patches.subject: fix: stabilize autocomplete and optimization behavior
items: Autocomplete no longer compounds special-recipe sizing between passes, and recipes already on the canvas are kept in the plan.

Ratio Optimizer and Complete Production now remember separate metric settings. Power Output was removed from optimizer metrics; the optimizer now minimizes Produced Pollution while the dashboard keeps Net Pollution.

Autocomplete errors include a downloadable trace. When recipe settings cycle, it re-solves locked route choices, updates temperatures, and applies a plan only after the generated graph passes verification.
Native flow checks now use the shared precision tolerances, avoiding failures on negligible numerical residuals.

patches.subject: feat: add offline support and a 404 page
items: The app can be installed and reopens its cached shell offline after it has loaded once. Product icons and solver files are cached after download.
Before a service-worker update, open tabs save their graphs. A failed save leaves the current session open and offers a retry.
Autosaves are separated by browser tab and are written when a tab is hidden, helping prevent one tab from overwriting another.
Unknown app paths now show a 404 page. The service worker also keeps the solver license notice available offline.
The data comparator explains when wiki data has not been fetched yet.

patches.subject: fix: improve machine precision, autocomplete convergence, and optimizer summaries
items: Whole-machine rounding now handles values just above an integer consistently in JavaScript and the native solver.
Documented and checked the rounding tolerance used by machine-count objectives.
Autocomplete now sizes special recipes from their original settings on each pass, so repeated solves do not compound changes.
Temperature and recipe-setting changes are included when checking whether autocomplete has settled; it reports an error if they keep changing.
Optimizer summaries now use the counts and flows that Apply will put on the canvas. Totals stay the same when no changes are needed.

patches.subject: fix: simplify native SCIP execution and stabilize thermal solving
items: The optimizer now uses a single-threaded SCIP WebAssembly build in its browser Worker; it no longer needs cross-origin isolation.
Balancing temperature-sensitive recipes now uses the full connected graph and current solve results.
Unconnected Boilers and Heat Exchangers now show the same outputs in the selector and on the canvas. Connected recipes still use propagated temperatures.

patches.subject: fix: harden wiki data comparison and proxy errors
items: Improved wiki data comparison when records or proxy responses are incomplete.
Added restore and delete controls for special and modular recipe data.
Corrected Modular Diesel Engine power and component calculations, and fixed several optimizer and autocomplete cases.

patches.subject: fix: correct Chemical Plant formula
items: Corrected the Chemical Plant formula.

patches.subject: fix: improve production-chain placement, recipes, solver reliability, and tutorials
items: Recipe nodes now appear closer to the port where they were added, and the first-chain tutorial uses Gearbox as its example.
The balancer now shares supply across multiple connected inputs before changing machine counts.
Updated Research Station 3, Satellite Dish Controller, HV Transformer, and recipes with discardable outputs.
Added experimental Complete Production, which searches for upstream recipes for existing targets.
Machine counts can now be locked or capped, and both limits are shown on the canvas and respected by Compute.
Aligned solver tolerances and improved Data Comparator sorting.

patches.subject: feat: rebuild ratio optimization around native SCIP and configurable objectives
items: Replaced the ratio solver with a native SCIP and SoPlex WebAssembly model that runs in a browser Worker.
Compute now reduces shortages and sink excess before optimizing the metrics you choose. Metrics can be weighted and ordered by priority.
Added whole-machine accounting for machine cost, space, and model count, alongside faster fractional estimates.
Added result comparisons for machine counts, power, pollution, cost, space, and model count. Production Stats also gained separate MV/HV power totals, profit, and research infrastructure totals.
Improved handling of large targets, infinite-cost machines, flow scaling, and returned solver values.
Moved native solves into a reusable Worker with progress updates, telemetry, and cancellation. Added a pinned Docker build and native smoke tests for the WebAssembly bundle.
